common_causal_window.bound_semantics: CLOSED interval on 5m bar-OPEN times: bar_open_time_ms in [start_ms, end_ms]
common_causal_window.decision_eligibility_semantics: a decision at aligned slot t requires: leader bars t-BAR_MS and t (completed), the 288 trailing leader return references t-289*BAR_MS..t-2*BAR_MS, the follower bars t-BAR_MS and t (completed), and the follower entry bar t+BAR_MS plus the follower exit bar t+2*BAR_MS inside the admitted partitions
common_causal_window.derivation: INTERSECTION of the admitted ARC-02 projection partitions of all three assets on 5m bar-OPEN times (max of first opens, min of last opens)
common_causal_window.engineering_closure_required: a decision whose entry bar (t+BAR_MS) or exit bar (t+2*BAR_MS) would exceed end_ms is NOT emitted (NO_SIGNAL / INSUFFICIENT_FORWARD_PRICE_DATA). The last two 5m slots of the window therefore produce no trades; this is a frozen clock-censoring guard, not a data defect.

funding_authority.reason: the frozen holding period is 5 minutes; BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT settle every 8h (one settlement per 480 five-minute slots) and SOLUSDT ran a 2h/4h schedule in 2022-11, so a hold can and does contain a settlement. Funding cashflow is therefore frozen rather than omitted.

projection.rationale: the lead-lag rule reads completed 5m closes (leader/follower log returns) and 5m opens (entry/exit anchors) only. Volume, quote volume, trade count and taker-buy fields are absent from the ARC-02 projection, so ARC-02 cannot structurally read the H5 order-flow family or the ARC-03 participation field.
